summary: React Query Migration Batch 4 - Tested 6 migrated components. Found and fixed 2 critical bugs in GanttChart.js. All pages now working.

bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.issue: useEffect used but not imported from React - caused 'useEffect is not defined' error
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.fix: Added useEffect to React imports: import React, { useState, useContext, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react'

bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.issue: setTasks function called but not defined - React Query migration left orphan code that used legacy state setter. This caused 'setTasks is not a function' error when dragging tasks
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.fix: Added local state for tasks to support drag operations: const [tasks, setTasks] = useState([]); with useEffect to sync from React Query data. Added JSON.stringify comparison to prevent infinite update loop.

test_results.Office Locations Settings: PASS - Page loads correctly, shows geofencing info and empty location list
test_results.Gantt Chart: PASS - Fixed 2 bugs, page loads with project selector and timeline
test_results.Project Payment Details: PASS - Payment schedule and consultant breakdown tabs work
test_results.Project Roadmap: PASS - Page loads, Create Roadmap button available
test_results.Project Tasks: PASS - Task list view and timeline view functional
test_results.HR Staffing Requests: PASS - Stats cards and requests list displayed

critical_code_review_comments: GanttChart.js had incomplete React Query migration - missing useEffect import and orphan setTasks call. This is a common pattern issue when migrating from useEffect+useState to React Query.
Some backend endpoints return 404 but pages handle errors gracefully. These may be intentional (no data) or missing backend routes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: React Query Migration Batch 4 complete. 6 pages tested and working. Key bugs fixed in GanttChart.js: 1) Missing useEffect import, 2) setTasks function undefined - needed local state for drag operations with sync from React Query. 55 total components migrated (from main agent note), 33 remaining.
